Corrections Christina gave on drafted Arabizi questions (2026-11-14):
- "ekher marra" (last time) needs a past marker: "2adesh **ken** 7a2 el bantalon ekher marra", not "2adesh 7a2 ... ekher marra" (reads as "how much is it last time").
- "fwatir" = receipts, "fwatire" = MY receipts. "shu fi fwatir men Spinneys hal shaher" is right; "shu fi fwatire men..." is wrong.
- "should" = **lezem**: "shu ra2yak lezem wa2ef eshteri la wafir".
- "How much": aday/adday more common than adde; also use adesh, 2adesh, addesh, adaysh, addeh. Receipts: fwatir/fwatire more common than fawatir/fawatire.
- Usual/average: 3adatan / aadatan / bel 3ade far more common than moyenne; motawassit is not used.

**Why:** she is the native speaker judging the dataset; wrong grammar teaches the model bad Arabizi.
**How to apply:** check every Arabizi question I write against these before showing or adding it. Related: [[fyp-backend-structure-preferences]]

Price change: zed / ghele (went up), na2as / ne2sit / no2is (went down), m3adal = average, bl miyye = in percent. "ha2o/ha2a" alone needs CLARIFY, but after an item question it is a follow-up (ha2o m, ha2a f).

NEVER "sa7abit menne": "aya 3 categories sarafet aalayon aktar shi" (vary with kalafoune / kalafuni). NEVER "adde ra7 men jaybte" (use aday sarafet 3a X). NEVER "emta bekhlas ma3ashe". - (2026-11-20) **bi = in, mn / men = since** ("bi kanoun l awal" = in December, "mn kanoun l awal" = since December). "f" is never used ("f kanoun el awal" came from batch 1's writer).
- (2026-11-20) "how much have I spent on it so far": **aday sar masroufe aalay** (NEVER "adde sar le masrouf 3leh"). "since December": **mn kanoun l awal** ("kam dollar sarle sarfe mn kanoun l awal"; not "f kanoun el awal"). Fine: sarli def3a, sar masroufe, sarle 3am / sarle aam jib, sarle def3a; "kam dollar" is fine (counting dollars).
- (2026-11-20, "atrocious use of kam") **kam = only for COUNTING** things: kam marra, kam fatoura, kam ta7wile. For an amount of MONEY never kam: aday / adesh / adeysh / adde ("aday dakhle", not "kam dakhle"; "ahle aday sarafo", not "ahle kam sarafo").

- (2026-11-22, shortcuts) "the things I bought": vary **yali / li + jebton / jebta / jebto**, not only "li jebton". "shu hene el ghrad li jebta" is correct, but **"shu el ghrad li / yali jebta" is the most common**. Agreement: plural things -> jebton or jebta; a masculine singular (el shi, el 7elo) -> jebto; el la7me -> jebta. Medicines: **edewye / 2edewye** (not adwye). **talabton** = I ordered them (delivery, Toters) is a good form. **"aam jibon" is habitual** (what I usually buy): never with ekher marra. "Carefour" is her spelling of Carrefour.
